## Result
A complete, independently reviewed negative answer to the pinned AIM question: a graph-defined degree-11 algebraic critically fixed rational-map class has field of moduli contained in the reals in the chosen embedding, but no real model. It therefore has no model over its field of moduli.

The construction uses the established critically fixed plane-graph classification. The proof supplies the intrinsic symmetry action, an actual invariant charge graph, the reflection obstruction, algebraicity and the field-of-moduli argument. Historical novelty and minimal degree are unestablished. No coefficient list, exact number field, or total-reality claim is made.

## Verification
- Separate adversarial review: PASS for unchanged proof SHA-256 `aa598dc779b4115c9a7522335b364a5d9dcddf11ceec707fd46943984e8ffabf`
- Author verifier exhausts 1,152 degree-compatible vertex permutations
- Independent verifier passes 183 exact assertions; both receipts reproduced exactly
- Review Section 6 explicitly justifies algebraic conjugators

The finite checks do not replace the mathematical proof. Independent AI review is not formal verification or peer review.

## Source limits
The live AIM problem-list page could not be recovered. The exact question is preserved in the authorized pinned canonical record, while the official workshop announcement/report and relevant primary literature were checked. Known pseudo-real and antipodal dynamics are credited; the withdrawn 2024 preprint is not used as an established theorem.

Research artifacts are confined to `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20001424/`.
